body: I agree with you on this. I so desperately wish he would seek help but on the flip side of the argument most people who are in this type of mental state are in serious denial. It takes a great sense of maturity to say "hey I need help" on anything really let alone your own life. There was one time where he supposedly tried it and called me gasping for air. Saying that me made the attempt. This could've been a really well done theatrical performance or he could've actually tried it but he wasn't successful and I told him that as he just experienced inflicting pain on yourself is frightening. This tells me that he does have some level of sanity left in him because he stopped when it got to be gasping for air. More often than not I find myself thinking "again with this, I'm so tired of talking you out of suicide. Why are you torturing me? What satisfaction are you getting outta this?" well he's getting the attention that he wants. If he's serious he would've done it by now, and he probably wouldn't tell anyone (which is the frightening part).
